svg.title: E for Execution and Production Art
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. The E develops into an ascending staircase and a completed checkmark, then introduces execution and production art through final artwork, preflight, and print-ready production. The original E artwork is traced into editable vector paths.
svg.metadata: 16:9; 1920 by 1080; 6.5-second loop; derived from 05_E_execution.png; no external assets.

g.text: PRECISION IN EVERY DETAIL. READY FOR PRODUCTION.
